requirements.text: Real-time notifications for all account transactions, including transaction details, merchant names, and updated balances.
Implement both fingerprint and facial recognition as biometric authentication options.
Create a streamlined in-app lending process that allows customers to apply for personal loans, overdraft increases, or credit limit changes.
Include a feature for customers to check their credit score directly in the app.
Implement pre-filled application forms to minimize effort for customers applying for loans.
Provide clear and transparent information about loan terms, interest rates, and the application process.
Ensure customer data is processed and stored within the European Economic Area (GDPR Compliance).
Implement Strong Customer Authentication (SCA) for payment initiations and sensitive account access (PSD2 Compliance).
Adhere to Central Bank regulations regarding consumer protection and responsible lending.
